from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from a single company's document for asset categorization."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reported in the document")
    net_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The Net Assets value extracted; negative numbers indicate negative assets")
    net_assets_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label used in the document for Net Assets (e.g. 'Total Stockholders'' Equity', 'Total Partners'' Capital')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The date or period this financial figure represents")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_data: list[CompanyAssetInfo]
